name: Summer at JWU – Summer Cooking Camps for Kids and Teens (Providence)
operator_name: Johnson & Wales University – College of Food Innovation & Technology (CFIT)
description_short: Week-long cooking day camps at Johnson & Wales University's Providence campus, taught by College of Food Innovation & Technology instructors. There is a kids camp for ages 8-12 and a teens camp for ages 13-17. Both cover culinary and baking/pastry work and run 8:30am-4pm.
refund_policy_summary: Payments are nonrefundable unless JWU gets written notice of cancellation at least 30 days ahead. If JWU cancels a camp (health/safety reasons or low enrollment), it refunds the cancelled portion on a pro-rated basis.

warnings: The page only covers the 2025 season, which is over (today is 2026-10-13). No 2026 or 2027 dates or prices are posted.
The page said 2025 registration was full and offered a waitlist by email or phone. That status applied to 2025 only.
There are two weekly rates: $600 for kids (8-12) and $700 for teens (13-17). price_per_week is left blank for that reason.
The street address is the university's general contact address in the page footer. The page does not say this is where the camp is held.
No primary category fits cooking/culinary well, so none was assigned.
